claims.statement: `sem install` verifies SQLite FTS5, optionally downloads a curated GGUF model, writes a default config if missing, force-rebuilds the index, notifies a running daemon, and warms the synthesis provider.

The suggested default configuration prefers local_gguf when a managed model and runtime exist, otherwise Ollama with the recommended model when available, otherwise tier0; embeddings default to fastembed_local.
`sem update` performs a non-forced index build that re-parses documentation, upserts changed tools, prunes uninstalled tools, and notifies a running daemon; it does not warm the synthesis provider.

`sem doctor` reports index completeness, stored and expected revision, last-indexed time, staleness, corpus and coverage stats, source counts, unindexed PATH binaries, provider configuration, local GGUF runtime, and daemon status, exiting 1 when the index is incomplete.

`sem configure` interactively selects synthesis and embedding providers and models, defaulting synthesis to local_gguf then ollama then openai_compatible then tier0, and advises an update when embeddings change.

Staleness compares last_indexed against the first existing package database among Debian, Arch, Fedora, RPM legacy, Alpine, Homebrew, and Nix paths plus user ~/.local/bin and ~/.cargo/bin, treating a missing marker as stale and requiring no watched paths to report not stale.
The query-time staleness warning is suppressed in porcelain mode and never blocks a query.
Index incompatibility errors cover missing/incomplete metadata, revision mismatch, provider or model mismatch, and a missing tool embedding file, and instruct the user to run sem update.
The FastEmbed model is cached under the application data directory's embeddings folder so subsequent runs can work offline.
`sem install` accepts --offline, --no-tldr, --no-help-probe, --skip-embeddings, and --model, while `sem update` accepts --full, --offline, --no-tldr, --no-help-probe, and --skip-embeddings.
`sem config show/get/set/wizard` print TOML, read one key, coerce and save one key, or run the interactive wizard; malformed keys exit 2, unknown keys exit 3, and unsupported providers exit 2.
`sem daemon status/start/stop/restart` inspect or control the Unix-socket daemon, and install, update, model, and config changes notify a running daemon to reload.
The curated model catalog has tiny, balanced, and quality tiers at roughly 398 MB, 986 MB, and 1930 MB, with minimum RAM of 2, 4, and 8 GB; downloads come from Hugging Face into the data directory.
